::: {#hero-heading}
Ibnu Ariyanto is a lecturer and researcher in biomedical science and clinical microbiology at Universitas Indonesia. His work focuses on infectious immunology, particularly cellular immune responses to viral infections such as HIV and CMV. He is also involved in laboratory services, serology, molecular diagnostics, virology, and genomic research development at the Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia.


## Education

Doctor of Biomedical Science, Universitas Indonesia

Master of Biomedical Science, Universitas Indonesia

Bachelor’s Degree, Universitas Gadjah Mada

## Current Roles
Lecturer and researcher, Master Program of Biomedical Science, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia

Member of the Department of Clinical Microbiology, FMUI

Person in Charge of Serology Division, Laboratory services contributor, UKK PPM LMK FKUI

Person in Charge of Clinical Validation Services, UKK PPM LMK FKUI

Contributor to genomic research and services in Molecular and Virology Divisions, UKK PPM LMK FKUI


## Laboratory

Department of Microbiology, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia
